feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
entry.summary: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

entry.title: People along the Gulf Coast prepare for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Isaias became the first hurricane of the Atlantic season late Wednesday. It's expected to make landfall along the U.S. Gulf Coast Friday.

entry.title: Teen arrested for alleged shooting plot at the Mall of America, authorities say
entry.summary: Federal prosecutors say a teenager is under arrest, under suspicion of plotting a mass shooting at Minnesota's Mall of America.

entry.title: ICE has quietly used this warehouse as a detention facility all summer, neighbors say
entry.summary: Throughout the summer, rumors have been bubbling in North New Jersey that ICE has quietly been using a warehouse as a detention center. NPR investigated.

entry.title: Flock is catching flak. Experts say other police surveillance tools are more worrisome
entry.summary: Real-time crime-center software is a sometimes overlooked but powerful tool allowing police to aggregate immense amounts of data, significantly expanding their surveillance reach.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Gulf Coast residents prepare for Hurricane Isaias, with midterms just weeks away, a look at the state of play for the House, media companies barred from White House return to court.

entry.title: FBI teams that investigate foreign espionage hit by cuts, NPR finds
entry.summary: NPR has exclusive reporting that under the Trump administration, the FBI teams that work on catching foreign spies have been hit with major staffing cuts.

entry.title: Cornell students call for change amid reopened investigation into alleged assault
entry.summary: Student groups at Cornell organized a seven-hour sit-in Wednesday to protest the University's handling of the 2024 rape allegations.

entry.title: A look at the legal fight ahead following Christa Pike's botched execution
entry.summary: Christa Pike's attorneys say she regained consciousness after surviving two lethal injections. It's not clear what will happen to her next.

entry.title: Trump wants to turn one of his Florida golf clubs into a Camp David-style retreat
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Antonio Fins, Palm Beach Post politics editor, about his report of President Trump's proposed presidential golf retreat in South Florida.
